identificationModule.briefTitle: Identification of Novel Biomarkers of Cervicovaginal Mucosal Inflammation
identificationModule.officialTitle: Identification of Novel Biomarkers of Cervicovaginal Mucosal Inflammation

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study investigates the response of vaginal and cervical tissue after exposure to three vaginal products: hydroxyethyl cellulose (HEC) placebo, nonoxynol-9 (N9) and imiquimod (IMQ) cream.

keywords: Vaginal innate immune and inflammatory responses

armGroups.label: Imiquimod, 2 doses, vaginally
armGroups.description: Participants first have sampling in the follicular and luteal phases of the menstrual cycle. Then participants receive 4 doses of HEC placebo gel in the luteal phase. Finally, participants are randomized to the order of IMiquimod, 2 doses vaginally, in the luteal phase and nonoxynol-9, 4%, 4 doses vaginally in the luteal phase.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Differential Microarray gene expression (particularly looking at pathways involved in inflammation and immune response) in vaginal tissues after exposure to N9, HEC or imiquimod
primaryOutcomes.description: These data are still undergoing analysis
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Biopsies are performed 8 - 18 hours after exposure to each product
